abstract.p: We present an LLM-based method for the Slavic NLP 2025 shared task on detection and classification of persuasion techniques in parliamentary debates and social media. Our system uses OpenAI's GPT models (gpt-4o-mini) and reasoning models (o4-mini) with chain-ofthought prompting, enforcing a ≥ 0.99 confidence threshold for verbatim span extraction. For subtask 1, each paragraph in the text is labeled "true" if any of the 25 persuasion techniques is present. For subtask 2, the model returns the full set of techniques used per paragraph.
